subject.title: fix embedded compaction hook reset API

question: Should after-compaction hooks gain a supported current-session reset API with committed-reset notification guarantees?
rationale: This adds a permanent plugin capability and defines which compaction runtimes may rotate persisted session state; code review cannot choose that public contract without owner intent.

options.title: Approve the narrow API after fixes
options.body: Keep the current-session-only deferred design, add standard committed-reset notification, split unrelated runtime policy, and require end-to-end proof before merge.

options.title: Keep reset policy internal
options.body: Do not expose a plugin API; implement compaction recovery as an owner-controlled core or context-engine policy instead.

options.title: Defer to broader lifecycle design
options.body: Pause this PR until reset, compaction, and plugin lifecycle APIs are designed together with explicit compatibility semantics.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow API after fixes
recommendation.body: Keep the current-session-only deferred design, add standard committed-reset notification, split unrelated runtime policy, and require end-to-end proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history most directly connects this person to the reset service and its committed lifecycle semantics.
